what: Pre-registration DRAFT, CEF trial 53: the live book's volatility target raised by a per-account sizing multiplier (core x1.24, C4 x1.41 as ruled by the team lead 2026-10-29/30). Zero trials spent by writing it; the counter stays 52 until the team lead approves.
declared_before: every computation in results/cef/prereg_voltarget/: the reproduction and per-account conversion of the multipliers, C4's multiplier on its spec book, the plateau grid on the two-account model, the per-account P(HALVE)/P(KILL) at the ruled multipliers, the exact-implementation fits, and the calibration of the raise-specific stops.
prior_information_disclosed: SCRATCH/alloc/tables/t8_vol_grid.csv and t9_sigma_star.csv (2026-10-28): two-sleeve one-account book, sigma_margin 5.958%, sigma* 5.75%, combined multipliers core 0.6219 / C4 0.7030, 9.25%/yr gross on the fit path, cap binding 49%

SCRATCH/alloc_review/r3_portfolio.py and proxy_snapshot_sensitivity.csv (2026-10-29): the per-account conversion x2 (1.24 / 1.41), and two-sleeve P(HALVE) SB63 1.2-11.8% across the 10 core books on the one-account model

SCRATCH/alloc4/tables/m_books.csv (2026-10-29): 'core + C4 only (2 accounts)' under the 2026-10-29 rule has sigma* 5.25% (term d), account multipliers 1.1357 / 1.2712, core-account P(KILL) on W2 median 3.2%, max 17.3%
The drafting brief's summary: about 9% gross on the fit, realistic Sharpe 1.2-1.5, P(HALVE in 12m) 4-6%, the 2008 tail unmeasured

implementation_choice.chosen: B: a new optional frozen key `sizing_multiplier` in each cef_discount-type spec (the core's cef_discount.frozen.json; C4's c4_families.frozen.json). ABSENT = today, byte for byte. Present = m: the sleeve builds its unit book exactly as today (vol_target_annual unchanged), compares the band against held/m, applies _cap_gross at max_gross_stress/m in unit-book weights (= max_gross_stress x account NAV), and emits m x the weights. Held targets stay in shares.
why_chosen_on_mechanism_before_any_imple: C4's fidelity gate compares the live sleeve's w at the min_abs_weight read with build_book's T, and its own negative controls are vol_target_annual x 1.1 and gross_leverage: either key moved breaks the gate. Under B the compared object is untouched.

B is the model the multipliers were derived under (the house rescaling convention: m x the sleeve's decided book, one uniform cap per account, P&L f_{d-2} x uncapped). Changing vol_target_annual instead narrows the band relative to the book (4.8% absolute on a book 1.24x larger) and moves the vol-scalar clip, so the traded book is not the derived one.

The core keeps its single-sleeve path, so the missing-NAV hold (data.missing_nav, switched on 2026-10-29) keeps working; the combiner route refuses missing_nav with risk_budget, and its b is bounded to (0, 1] with sigma_book from the book spec, so it cannot express m > 1 for a one-sleeve account without a second spec.
spec.VOL_TARGET is read by research code beyond the core (the ex-date sleeve's k, the PCEF k rule, band_frontier.build_targets, real_money_costs, portfolio_baseline). Under B none of them moves.
implementation_choice.information_only_not_deciding: A: vol_target_annual 0.06 -> 0.06 x m on the core, run through band_frontier at the same m, to price what B avoids. Computed beside, never deciding.

multiplier_rule: The 2026-10-28 declared rule (SCRATCH/alloc/declared_threshold.json, 2026-10-28T21:40:27Z): sigma* = min(sigma_cap 20%, sigma_kill at p* 5%, sigma_margin, half-Kelly@15bp) on the combined book, rounded down to the 0.25% grid; weights equal standalone vol. Combined multipliers m_k = sigma* b_k / (sd_k sd_c) on W1 (2013-06-25 -> 2022-12-30); per-account multiplier = m_k x (combined NAV / account NAV) = 2 m_k for two $100k accounts (the review's correction). Written to two decimals, ROUNDED DOWN (a risk multiplier is never rounded up). Reported on both C4 series: the trial's 1.80 book (the ruled 1.41) and the 1.90 spec book (the book paper trades and H11 reads, team lead 2026-10-29).
plateau_check: The two-account model at combined targets 4.00% .. 7.50% in 0.25% steps (the ruled multipliers sit at 5.75%), total return and price only: gross Sharpe, gross return, each account's cap-binding share and mean uncapped gross. The derived point is on a plateau if every grid point within +-0.50% of it has a gross Sharpe within 0.05 of it. The argmax of Sharpe and of return over the full 2.00% .. 20.00% grid are named and not chosen.
risk_statistics: At the ruled multipliers (and the spec-book alternative): per account and combined, P(drawdown >= risk.halve_drawdown) and P(>= risk.kill_drawdown) within 252 sessions, SB21 / SB63 / GAUSS (10,000 paths, portfolio_baseline.stationary_index), zero edge (decides nothing here: this is a report) and fit edge, total return and price only, on W1 and on W2 (2005-02-22 -> 2022-12-30, the core before 2013-06-25 as the fixed-book group proxy at each of the 10 year-end books 2013..2022; min / median / max reported). HALVE does not act (report mode is today's state). Each account's cap-binding share, mean held gross, worst drawdown on W1 and W2 (range over the 10 books), and the same at today's sizing (x1.0) beside.

raise_specific_stops.R1_drawdown_any_time: Revert an account's multiplier (delete the key, that account only) when its drawdown from the high-water mark on Alpaca's end-of-day portfolio history (the P&L of record), measured from the first session the raise trades, reaches D_R = the LARGEST over SB21 / SB63 / GAUSS of the 95th percentile of the 252-session maximum drawdown of that account's raised fit series at the FIT edge, the worse of total return and price only, on the account's own fit window (core 2013-06-25 -> 2022-12-30; C4 2005-02-22 -> 2022-12-30), but never above the spec's risk.halve_drawdown. Re-measured on the read date by stops.py (H14); the drafting-day value is information.
raise_specific_stops.R2_horizon_120: At 120 armed sessions of the raise: revert if the account's cumulative gross return on the P&L of record is below the 5th percentile of 120-session cumulative PRICE-ONLY returns of the raised fit series (SB21, fit edge), re-measured on the read date.
raise_specific_stops.R3_vol_60: At 60 armed sessions of the raise: revert if the account's realised daily vol on the P&L of record (annualised) is above the 95th percentile of the 60-session realised vol of the raised fit series (SB21), re-measured on the read date. This is the trial's falsifier: the risk the multiplier buys is larger than the model says.
raise_specific_stops.who_acts: The team lead, through /spec-change. No acting mode exists on the runner (drawdown is report-only, team lead 2026-10-19); these are read rules, not code.

fit_only: Every frame that enters a statistic ends by 2022-12-30, asserted. No 2023+ return is computed.
